idle.goalPlaceholder: For example: fix the cart total and add a test for empty carts
idle.goalHint: Describe the result you want. Ctrl+Enter starts the run.
idle.noModel: No model is running. The agents need a local model.
idle.modelCrashed: The model stopped unexpectedly. Start it again in the models view.
idle.toolCallsFailed: This model does not call tools reliably, so agents may stop early. A stronger model works better.
idle.noProject: No folder is open. The agents need a project to work in.
idle.openTasks_one: One task is still open. Continuing picks it up first.
idle.openTasks_other: {{count}} tasks are still open. Continuing picks them up first.

mode.label: Approvals
mode.askHint: Agents read the project on their own, but every change, deletion and command waits for your click.
mode.autoSafeHint: Reads and undoable edits run automatically, while commands and deletions ask first.
mode.autonomousHint: Everything runs automatically, except what the two switches below still guard.
mode.unguardedCommands: Agents run commands without asking. Their effects cannot be undone.
mode.unguardedDeletes: Agents delete files without asking. You can restore them from the checkpoints.
mode.unguardedBoth: Agents run commands and delete files without asking. Effects of commands cannot be undone.

run.stopBody: The agents stop right away. Changes made so far stay in place, and you can undo them from the checkpoints.

next.label: What should the agents do next?
next.placeholder: For example: now add a test for discount codes
next.hint: The agents know this run’s goal, tasks and changed files. Ctrl+Enter continues.
next.hintOpen_one: The agents know this run’s goal, tasks and changed files, and first finish the open task. Ctrl+Enter continues.
next.hintOpen_other: The agents know this run’s goal, tasks and changed files, and first finish the {{count}} open tasks. Ctrl+Enter continues.
next.otherProject: This run belongs to another project. Start a new run for this one.

agents.heading: Agents
agents.interveneSent: Sent. {{agent}} reads it before the next step.

tasks.planning: The orchestrator is planning the tasks.

feed.stored: Runs from an earlier session keep no activity log, only their goal, tasks, result and changed files.
feed.approvedAlways: You approved {{title}} and allowed `{{tool}}` for the rest of this run

checkpoints.empty: Checkpoints appear when a task starts. They let you undo what the agents changed.
checkpoints.intro: Before each task, Ylide keeps a copy of every file the agents touch.
checkpoints.busyHint: Pause or stop the run to undo changes.
checkpoints.confirmBody: All changes the agents made from “{{label}}” on are reverted. The files return to how they were before this step.
checkpoints.confirmWarning: Effects of shell commands, such as installed packages or files created outside the project, cannot be undone.

approval.undoable: You can undo this later from the checkpoints.
approval.notUndoable: Commands can change things outside the project files. Their effects cannot be undone.
approval.approveAlwaysHint: Approve for this run lets the agents use {{tool}} without asking again until the run ends.
approval.reasonHint: The agent reads it and chooses another approach.

live.approval: An agent is waiting for your approval.
